title: Folded Banks: 3D-Stacked HBM Design for Fine-Grained Random-Access Bandwidth
problem: HBM has seen substantial improvements in sequential (peak) bandwidth across generations but irregular/random-access bandwidth has stagnated, limiting performance for applications with non-sequential memory access patterns such as graph analytics, recommendation, and sparse workloads.
motivation: Real-world workloads frequently exhibit irregular memory access patterns that cannot benefit from HBM's sequential bandwidth improvements, making fine-grained random-access bandwidth the critical missing dimension in HBM scaling.
method: Folded Banks redistributes DRAM bank subarrays vertically across stacked silicon dies and moves the control logic and sense amplifiers to a dedicated logic layer at the base. Signals travel vertically through tiny connections called through-silicon vias (TSVs) and hybrid bonds instead of along long horizontal paths, dramatically reducing power loss from electrical resistance. Self-timed sense amplifiers (which detect when stored charge is ready to read) eliminate the need for dummy test subarrays, adding further power and area savings.
key_novelty: Folding bank subarrays vertically across stacked dies with vertical signal routing and a dedicated logic layer eliminates the power and area penalties of long horizontal wiring, enabling fine-grained random memory access.
contributions: FB-HBM architecture that folds bank subarrays across multiple 3D-stacked DRAM dies
Dedicated base layer in logic process for command/control and global sense amplifiers, eliminating die-level overheads
Vertical CSL and MDL routing via thin-pitch TSVs and hybrid bonds reducing RC losses
Self-timed sense amplifiers that replace power-hungry dummy subarrays in conventional DRAM

metrics.other: 6.4x increase in sequential bandwidth over two HBM generations cited as baseline gap; random-access improvement metric not quantified in abstract

limitations: Not discussed in abstract; specific random-access bandwidth improvement numbers and full system performance impact on real applications are not stated.
primary_theme: 3D-stacked HBM bank folding for fine-grained random-access bandwidth
